newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE March wheat down A$1.00/t in light trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE March wheat down A$1.00/t in light trade.

text.p: Australian wheat futures prices retreated on Tuesday in light trading.

Grains traders said the local market took its cue from softening of prices in the U.S. where CBOT wheat futures closed mostly lower on Monday. Some traders remarked on the irony of the Australian market tracking CBOT, which some believe came under pressure due to news that Australia, rather than the U.S., had sold Egypt 110,000 tonnes of hard wheat.
Nearby March SFE wheat lost A$1.00 to last fetch at A$168.00 a tonne on volume of five lots traded.
Egypt said it paid $190.00 a tonne, C+F Egyptian
